card.name: Ordinal endings on dates in web posts
card.fires_on: The ending of an ordinal day number (th, nd) right after a month and day in a dated web post or byline. Weaker on a few nouns like age or application.

modes.label: Date ordinal ending
modes.description: The th or nd after a day number in a month-day-year date stamp.

modes.label: Stray nouns
modes.description: Occasional nouns such as age or application in form-like or disclaimer text.

card.plain: It fires on the th or nd at the end of a day number in a dated web post, such as September 11th, 2012.
